title: Training Walter Nelson, the Mid Drifts and arranging by ear
summary: He describes training a young guitarist and his group the Mid Drifts, and says arranging was done in the head and memorized; he lists tunes like Tipitina.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
